description:
Genes in a Plant Reactome pathway: pathway is a name or words from it ('jasmonic acid biosynthesis',
'gibberellin', 'flavonoid') or a stable ID (R-TAE-1119332). species: a species name as Plant Reactome writes it
('Triticum aestivum', 'Brassica napus', 'Glycine max'); default all species loaded for this site. Matching pathways
are listed with their genes per species. Membership is projected from rice by orthology.
name: pathway_genes
